strings.MENU_MISSION_01_01_DESC: Learn how to fight for the Motherland.
strings.MENU_MISSION_01_02_DESC: Repel the enemy assault and demolish their hardpoint.
strings.MENU_MISSION_02_01_DESC: Rush the trenches and raid the enemy supply depot.
strings.MENU_MISSION_02_02_DESC: Defend a small desert village on the British line south of El Alamein.
strings.MENU_MISSION_02_03_DESC: Assist your tanks in breaking through the Alamein line.
strings.MENU_MISSION_02_04_DESC: Capture the town of El Daba on the Mediterranean coast.
strings.MENU_MISSION_03_LEVEL_01_DESC: Repair the severed field phone line and destroy enemy tanks with sticky bombs.
strings.MENU_MISSION_03_LEVEL_02_DESC: Infiltrate via the pipeline and retake the trainyard.
strings.MENU_MISSION_04_LEVEL_01_DESC: Retake a series of apartment blocks in the city, and then support an attack on the enemy supply depot.
strings.MENU_MISSION_04_LEVEL_02_DESC: Fight through the streets to City Hall.
strings.MENU_MISSION_04_LEVEL_03_DESC: Use a sniper rifle to support the defense of City Hall.
strings.MENU_MISSION_05_LEVEL_01_DESC: Engage the superior tanks of the Afrika Korps in the Libyan desert.
strings.MENU_MISSION_05_LEVEL_02_DESC: Outflank and destroy 88mm anti-tank guns on a desert ridge in Libya.
strings.MENU_MISSION_06_LEVEL_01_DESC: Withdraw from Toujane in a captured armored car.
strings.MENU_MISSION_06_LEVEL_02_DESC: Drive the Afrika Korps out of the town of Toujane.
strings.MENU_MISSION_06_LEVEL_03_DESC: Secure the Matmata route to Tunis, and shoot down enemy planes using an anti-aircraft gun.
strings.MENU_MISSION_07_LEVEL_01_TITLE: The Battle of Pointe du Hoc
strings.MENU_MISSION_07_LEVEL_01_DESC: Locate and destroy the coastal guns and secure the enemy held bunkers.
strings.MENU_NMISSION_07_LEVEL_02_DESC: Repel a major counterattack at Pointe du Hoc.
strings.MENU_MISSION_07_LEVEL_03_DESC: Capture the village, then snipe enemy mortar teams from the top of the destroyed silo during the counterattack.
strings.MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_01_DESC: Reconnoiter the town of Beltot and then obtain a truck to transport wounded Americans.
strings.MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_02_DESC: Secure the crossroads at Anctoville and neutralize a German wireless station.
strings.MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_03_DESC: Capture the town hall, church, post office, and German field HQ in the town of St. Louet.
strings.MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_04_DESC: Capture a German field HQ, then repel the enemy counterattacks.
strings.MENU_MISSION_09_LEVEL_01_DESC: Clear the town at the foot of Hill 400, room by room, house by house.
strings.MENU_MISSION_09_LEVEL_02_DESC: Fight your way to the top and eliminate the German forces holding the hill.
strings.MENU_MISSION_09_LEVEL_03_DESC: Repel multiple counterattacks at the top of Hill 400 until friendly forces arrive.
strings.MENU_MISSION_10_LEVEL_01_DESC: Capture the German town of Wallendar and secure a crossing point on the Rhine River for the Allies.

strings.MPUI_THE_M1A1_CARBINE_IS_A: The M1A1 Carbine is a lightweight and accurate semi-automatic rifle. It lacks the stopping power of larger rifles, but its compact size provides greater mobility.
strings.MPUI_THE_M1_GARAND_IS_A_POWERFUL: The M1 Garand is a powerful and accurate semi-automatic rifle. Its primary drawback is that the en-bloc clip cannot be quickly reloaded when partially empty.
strings.MPUI_THE_THOMPSON_IS_DEADLY: The Thompson is deadly in close quarters, firing the powerful .45 ACP round. It is notoriously inaccurate beyond short ranges but compensates with a high rate of fire.
strings.MPUI_THE_BROWNING_AUTOMATIC: The Browning Automatic Rifle is a squad support weapon, used to lay down accurate suppression fire at enemy positions. It is most effective when used while prone.
strings.MPUI_THIS_IS_A_SNIPER_RIFLE: This is a sniper rifle equipped with a 4x zoom scope. It is best used while prone. As a bolt-action weapon, it has a slow rate of fire and reloads one round at a time.
strings.MPUI_THE_LEEENFIELD_RIFLE: The Lee-Enfield rifle is a bolt-action rifle, powerful and effective at long range. It carries up to ten rounds, loaded by two 5-round stripper clips.
strings.MPUI_THE_STEN_MARK_2_IS_A: The Sten Mark 2 is a 9mm submachine gun effective for clearing out rooms and trenches. Its light weight and compact frame provide excellent mobility.
strings.MPUI_THE_BREN_IS_AN_EXCELLENT: The Bren is an excellent machine gun in the role of squad support. Its large size limits mobility, but allows it to deliver accurate automatic fire when fired while prone.
strings.MPUI_THE_MOSINNAGANT_IS_A: The Mosin-Nagant is a bolt-action rifle capable of very accurate and powerful long range fire. However, its low rate of fire is a liability in close range combat.
strings.MPUI_THE_PPSH41_SUBMACHINE: The PPSh41 submachine gun holds 71 rounds of Soviet pistol ammo and has a very high rate of fire. It is ineffective at long range and fires a relatively weaker round.
strings.MPUI_THE_SCOPED_MOSINNAGANT: The Scoped Mosin-Nagant is the sniper variant of the Mosin-Nagant, carrying a 4x-zoom scope.
strings.MPUI_THE_KAR98K_IS_THE_STANDARD: The Kar98k is the standard issue German infantry rifle. It is accurate and deadly at long range, but suffers from a slow rate of fire due to its bolt-action mechanism.
strings.MPUI_THE_MP40_SUBMACHINE_GUN: The MP40 submachine gun is an effective room clearing weapon. It has a relatively minimal muzzle climb even when fired fully automatic in extended bursts.
strings.MPUI_THE_MP44_IS_AN_ASSAULT: The MP44 is an assault rifle that fires a unique 'short' rifle round. Up close, it can be used as a submachine gun, while at longer ranges it can operate as a rifle.
strings.MPUI_THIS_KAR98K_VARIANT_USES: This Kar98k variant uses the ZF-41 scope. Due to the high zoom, the scoped view is steadiest while prone. The scope's position forces rounds to be reloaded one at a time.
strings.MPUI_THE_SPRINGFIELD_M1903: The Springfield M1903 is a sniper rifle equipped with a 4x zoom scope. As a bolt-action weapon, it has a slow rate of fire and reloads one round at a time. It is best used while prone.
